bio: I'm Sultan Mahmud Saad, an embedded engineer and PCB designer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, with more than four years of hands-on experience building IoT products. I hold a B.Sc. in Electrical and Electronic Engineering from Gono Bishwabidyalay (2023), and since January 2025 I have worked as an Embedded System and PCB Designer at SIoT — Southern Innovation of Technology.

I take products from schematic to working firmware: 2-layer PCB design in EasyEDA and KiCad, embedded C/C++ with FreeRTOS on ESP32, Arduino and Raspberry Pi, and sensor integration over I²C, SPI and UART. My systems connect hardware to the cloud over LoRaWAN, MQTT, Wi-Fi and RS485/Modbus, for industrial uses such as real-time energy monitoring and production tracking, with Node-RED dashboards for monitoring and control.

I'm open to embedded and hardware engineering roles in Dhaka or remote, and to collaborating on open-source hardware, PCB design and robotics projects. I'm currently deepening my knowledge of embedded systems, ROS and IoT protocols.
